external_games.name: In my Father's House are Many Rooms

name: In my Father's House are Many Rooms
storyline: Princess Marissa von Teufelwald has never wanted for anything in her short life, even though she's never left her nursery. But when her favorite doll disappears, she's forced to undertake a strange and dangerous journey out into the wider house... a journey that will reveal the truth about herself, her home, and the family that she's never met.
summary: In my Father's House are Many Rooms is a point-and-click pixel horror game made in RPG Maker VX Ace.
